# Summers Infinite Cleaning

> Summers Infinite Cleaning, formerly Clean Wishes, is a locally owned, insured cleaning company in the Phoenix, Arizona metro, serving Phoenix (including North Phoenix and Laveen) and 15 nearby towns from Glendale and Peoria to Sun City West, Anthem and Scottsdale.

House, deep, recurring, move-in and move-out, and commercial cleaning, with eco-friendly products and 20% off the first clean. Free quotes: call or text (623) 300-8785, answered 24/7. Cleaning Monday to Saturday, 7am to 5pm.
